name: AWS first-seen: iam-permission-enumeration (behavioral)
description: Behavioral detection. Fires when (userIdentity.arn, eventName) is new for this principal in the last 90 days. Source rule: rules/discovery/iam-permission-enumeration.yml. Adjust field names to your Elastic CloudTrail mapping (e.g. aws.cloudtrail.* with the Fleet integration).
query: eventName:("ListAttachedUserPolicies" or "ListAttachedRolePolicies" or "ListGroupsForUser" or "SimulatePrincipalPolicy") and eventSource:"iam.amazonaws.com"
